scope: Complete public MassDecomposition value API; not the distinct mass-decomposition solvers.

source_literals.coverage: All distinct literal results in every active constructor/operator/accessor/predicate test section; repeated copy/assignment assertions share native cases.

source_quirks: First-parenthesis suffix truncation, and outer trim only in that branch. Literal-space split; count conversion signed i32.
Duplicate symbols overwrite counts but cached maximum never decreases.
Map-only ordering versus map-and-maximum string equality.
Addition ignores the right cached maximum and preserves the left cached maximum.
Zero keys remain significant for compatible; tags compare counts without order.
Compact formatter performs final ASCII whitespace trim even on control-byte symbols.
operator+ new-key branch compares against original-left maximum, permitting a later key to lower result cache; += compares running maximum instead. A1 + B10 C5 caches5, but += caches10.
native_corrections: Nonnegative checked counts instead of source signed-i32 to unsigned-Size negative conversion.
Checked usize additions rather than wrapping; in-place addition is atomic.
ASCII symbols and UTF-8 strings rather than platform signed-char ordering over arbitrary bytes.
Explicit source comparison separate from full-value Eq/Hash; no inconsistent Ord.
No stderr print for incompatible composition.
validation: Source-only inspection; native targeted tests on Rust1.98 and1.85, no C++ execution or runtime differential claim.
